acceptance.initialResult: task-red: the 3 deterministic server adapter tests passed, but the discovery browser test timed out because the delivered CapabilityCard stretched link was positioned against an ancestor and intercepted the Home search submit control.
acceptance.repair: Wrapped CapabilityCard route compositions in owned positioned containers without changing the reusable component.
acceptance.rerunResult: passed: 1 server test file with 3 tests and 1 Playwright discovery test.

notes: Routes compose the delivered AppShell, HomeSearch, DirectoryFilters, CapabilityCard, ApplicationCard, ApplicationDetail, ProviderChooser, and EmptyState components; reusable component implementation was not copied or edited.
Query input is trimmed and bounded to 120 Unicode code points, unknown facets normalize away, and catalog visibility is applied before DTOs reach routes.
Preference actions derive the user and viewer from App.Locals and rely on repository association and approved-endpoint eligibility checks; posted user IDs and external URLs are never accepted.
The current demo auth was left intact. Guests receive a clear local /login return flow that describes the demo boundary rather than implying Identikey/passkeys are complete.

Playwright creates and migrates a fresh temporary SQLite database, passes its path only to the isolated dev server, asserts approved link destinations without contacting live applications, and removes the database afterward.
bun run check, path-scoped Prettier and ESLint, bun run build, and bun run build-storybook passed. Storybook reported only its existing large-chunk warning.

The passing browser run logged Svelte non-reactive-binding warnings from the delivered DirectoryFilters component; that implementation is outside this node's owned paths and the tested filtering flow passed.

No commit was possible because the shared checkout has no initial HEAD, and the repository does not contain the intention conductor scripts. No fold, push, worktree, auth-internal, catalog, component, schema, or migration edits were made.
